sources.title: REVISITING HIERARCHICAL APPROACH FOR PERSISTENT LONG-TERM VIDEO PREDICTION
sources.snippet: Hierarchical approaches are potentially promising for long-term prediction since learning structure-aware dynamics allows the model to generate semantically accurate motion and content in the future.

sources.title: (PDF) Hierarchical Model for Long-term Video Prediction
sources.snippet: In this project, we use a hierarchical approach for long-term video prediction. We aim at estimating high-level structure in the input frame first, then predict how that structure grows in the future.
